edits.headline: RSS affiliate protests in Delhi against Starlink's India launch
edits.subheadline: The Swadeshi Jagran Manch has urged the government to deny Starlink a licence on security grounds, ThePrint reported.
editorialBody: Members of the Swadeshi Jagran Manch, a group affiliated to the RSS, protested in Delhi against Starlink, Outlook India reported. The group has urged the government to deny Elon Musk's company a licence on security grounds, ThePrint reported.

In Pakistan, the Baloch Liberation Front said it had carried out an attack in Gwadar that it called "Operation Almas", the Pakistan Observer reported. Security sources said no security personnel were killed, the paper reported.
A Delhi court allowed US national Matthew VanDyke, accused in a Myanmar training camp case, to stay abroad until 24 February, ThePrint reported.

In the US, President Trump backed Vivek Ramaswamy over a campaign ad featuring the estranged mother of Amy Acton, his Democratic opponent for Ohio governor, CBS News reported. Ohio Governor Mike DeWine condemned the ad, ABC News reported.
The Bombay High Court said its ban on bursting firecrackers on roads applies throughout the year, ThePrint reported.
A Sudanese drone attack on a market in Abyei killed more than 150 people, an official said, ThePrint reported.
